name: Penn Rec Camp
description_short: Recreation day camp on the University of Pennsylvania campus for ages 6 to 12, grouped by age. Campers play team sports and games, swim twice a week, rock climb, do crafts and eat lunch in a campus dining hall; Fridays are field day.
refund_policy_summary: Requests in writing. Up to one month and a day before camp, refunds less a $125 admin fee; the service fee is never refunded. No refunds within one month of the session.
swim_waterfront_notes: Recreational swim, not lessons. Campers take a swim test on the first day (swim the length of the pool and back, tread water 60 seconds); those who don't pass swim in a life jacket. Three lifeguards and four counselors in the pool.
notes: Camp 9 to 3 with check in 8 to 9; aftercare 3 to 5. Open to everyone ages 6 to 12, not only Penn families. Groups: Path Finders 6 to 7, Franklins 8 to 10, Quakers 11 to 12. Drop off behind the Pottruck Health and Fitness Center, 3724 Samson Street; pick up at Shoemaker Green. Run through Teamworks Camps. The site says summer 2027 dates are coming in December 2026. Weekly tuition is not posted on the camp's site.
